planets.name: WASP-84 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-84 with a 8.52-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: WASP-84 b was found in 2014 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around WASP-84. Its orbit and size follow Maciejewski et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
